title: Nike — stock performance diagnosis
note: Qualitative signals from the Nike_stock_analysis technical + fundamental study (no fabricated price figures).

signals.label: Earnings reaction
signals.detail: Market reacted unfavourably to the earnings report (weaker sales / softer outlook).

signals.label: CEO transition
signals.detail: Slight uptick, no stabilisation — not the primary cause of weakness.

signals.label: RSI (mid-Sept)
signals.detail: Losing bullish momentum; high volatility throughout.

signals.label: Valuation vs Adidas
signals.detail: Priced for future growth over current profitability — sensitive to earnings misses.

action_plan: Protect margins now: cost-cutting and supply-chain efficiency.
Double down on DTC & digital transformation (e.g. SNKRS) to defend the growth narrative.
Lead with innovation and manage earnings guidance to justify the premium valuation.
takeaway: Weakness is driven by an earnings miss and a stretched growth valuation, not the CEO change; defend margins and the DTC/innovation growth story.
